name: whatsapp_identity_events
description: Durable inbound identity receipts and short-lived challenge reservations scoped to a WhatsApp sender.
lifecycle: A reserved challenge stays active until it is replaced, consumed, expires or exhausts its attempts. Code digests are removed when the challenge is deactivated. Historical records support deduplication and hourly limits. Retention is release-plan work.

columns.Meaning: Hash of the business-scoped sender and provider message ID, used to recognize replay.
Stable hash of the business phone ID and preferred sender identity.
Keyed digest of the normalized corporate address for cross-sender limits.
columns.Null meaning: The receipt carries no eligible mailbox.

columns.Meaning: Clock instant when the event receipt was recorded.
Deadline for redemption of the reserved challenge.
columns.Null meaning: The receipt did not reserve a challenge.

columns.Meaning: Whether the reservation is the most recent active challenge for this sender.
Remaining comparisons allowed for this challenge.
GLPI user identified by a unique active directory match.
columns.Null meaning: The challenge has no verified directory candidate or has been deactivated.

columns.Meaning: Keyed digest of the short-lived verification code and sender scope.
columns.Null meaning: The event has no prepared code or its challenge was cleared.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((NOT active) OR ((expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (attempts_left > 0))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires an expiration and an available attempt for an active challenge.
Bounds challenge comparisons to the configured maximum of five.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((code_digest IS NULL) OR (active AND (glpi_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (glpi_user_id > 0) AND (code_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires a canonical digest and a valid directory candidate for a prepared active challenge.
Prevents one signed inbound message from starting or confirming verification twice for a sender.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_identity_events_mailbox_idx ON public.whatsapp_identity_events USING btree (mailbox_key, created_at)
constraints.Purpose: Supports the rolling hourly quota shared by all senders targeting a mailbox.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_identity_events_scope_idx ON public.whatsapp_identity_events USING btree (scope_key, created_at)
constraints.Purpose: Supports sender-scoped quotas and challenge selection.
